elements_selected.content: Implement Merkle hash prefix resolution per §3.3 resolution rule 1 and REQ-042a. Build a resolution index: for each file in the vault, iterate all MerkleLeaf hashes and store (full_hash_hex → list of (file, leaf)) mappings. At resolution time: 1) Filter entries whose full_hash_hex starts with the given prefix (case-insensitive), 2) Check result set: zero → error 'not found', 3) Check if all matching full hashes are identical (duplicate content case) → success, return all locations, 4) Multiple matches with different full hashes → error 'ambiguous prefix', list all with suggestion to use longer prefix. Resolution is position-independent: same content at any location resolves. Implement as resolve_hash_prefix(prefix: &str, index: &VaultHashIndex) -> HashResolutionResult where VaultHashIndex is built from loaded FileMerkle data. This function is shared by both zetl blocks --resolve (direct use) and source metadata validation. Implement in src/merkle.rs.
